prompt: Design a flat laser-cut plate in OpenSCAD as a 2D profile only; do not extrude it, because it will be exported to SVG. The outline is a 120 x 80 mm rectangle with its corner at the origin. Cut four 5 mm mounting holes 10 mm in from each edge, at X = 10 and X = 110, Y = 10 and Y = 70, and a 40 x 20 mm rectangular window centred in the plate. Use $fn = 64 for the holes and store the hole diameter in a variable named hole_d.
